SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400 AND sc.Virtual = 'F'
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 ORDER BY CDSCode
SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE enroll12 > 500 ORDER BY cds
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` > 500

SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS max_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(fr.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm fr
JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = fr.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL)/s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rnk
FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY rnk

SELECT MAX(1.0*f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`/f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS max_rate
FROM satscores s JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND (1.0*s.NumGE1500/s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT sc.CharterNum AS `Charter School Number`,
       s.AvgScrWrite AS `Average Score (Writing)`,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS `Rank`
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rank

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
   OR f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` - f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 30
ORDER BY f.CDSCode;

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT sc.CharterNum,
       s.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rnk
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND sc.Charter = 1
  AND s.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY rnk, sc.CharterNum

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
ORDER BY s.School, s.Street
SELECT f."School Name" FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1 AND s.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT f.`School Name`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 >= 1

SELECT f."School Name", s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30
ORDER BY f."School Name";

SELECT s.sname, sc.FundingType
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside' AND s.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.sname;

SELECT DISTINCT f."School Name"
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY f."School Name"

SELECT sc.School, sc.FundingType
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Riverside' AND sa.rtype = 'S' AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY sc.School;

SELECT f."School Name", s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS "Full Communication Address"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
ORDER BY f."School Name";
SELECT f.`School Name`, f.`Charter Funding Type` FROM frpm AS f JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE f.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' AND s.AvgScrMath > 400 ORDER BY f.`School Name`

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet, s.MailCity, s.MailState, s.MailZip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" DESC;

SELECT s.School, ss.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT s.School, sats.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools s JOIN satscores sats ON sats.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sats.rtype='S' AND (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR (s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'))

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey' AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` DESC;

SELECT sc.sname, sc.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sch.FundingType AS Funding_Type
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside' AND s.rtype = 'S' AND s.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY s.sname;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT f."School Name" AS School_Name, s.DOCType
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") >
      (SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
       FROM frpm
       WHERE "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded')
ORDER BY f."School Name"

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
ORDER BY f.`School Name`

SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.School, ss.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'

SELECT "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) >
      (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
       FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
       WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
SELECT "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" FROM frpm WHERE "Low Grade"='1' AND "High Grade"='12' ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 8;

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT sc.Street, sc.City, sc.State, sc.Zip
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
ORDER BY ss.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sch.Street, sch.City, sch.State, sch.Zip
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores s ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr
LIMIT 1

SELECT sc.AdmFName1 || ' ' || sc.AdmLName1 AS full_name
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = 66 AND s.GSoffered = '1-12'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(sa.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores sa JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND sa.rtype = 'S' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'

SELECT AVG(sa.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) = 1980;

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S' AND s.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School AS name,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5

WITH county_rank AS (
  SELECT sc.cds, sc.cname, sc.AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.cname ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rk
  FROM satscores sc
  WHERE sc.rtype = 'S' AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.School
FROM county_rank cr
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = cr.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND cr.rk <= 5
ORDER BY s.School;
SELECT ss.sname, ss.AvgScrWrite FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'

SELECT s.School, sat.AvgScrWrite FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE (s.AdmLName1 LIKE '%Ulrich%' OR s.AdmLName2 LIKE '%Ulrich%' OR s.AdmLName3 LIKE '%Ulrich%') AND sat.rtype = 'S'

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND DOC = '52' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = 52 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' AND County = 'Orange'
SELECT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT f.`School Name`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC='66'
  AND CAST(f.`Low Grade` AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12
  AND CAST(f.`High Grade` AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT sc.MailStreet, s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.sname IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name`='Los Angeles' AND `Charter School (Y/N)`=0 AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)`*100/`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;
SELECT SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.City='Fremont' AND s.EdOpsCode='SSS' AND f.`Academic Year`='2014-2015';

SELECT sch.Street, sch.City, sch.State, sch.Zip
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores s ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT schools.AdmFName1, schools.AdmLName1 FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School AS `School Name`,
       f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved='K-9' AND s.County='Los Angeles';

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOCType = 'Elementary School District'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';
SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND County IN ('San Diego','Santa Barbara') GROUP BY County ORDER BY cnt DESC;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "DOCType" = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN "DOCType" = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' AND County = 'Orange'
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(ss.NumTstTakr) FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31';
SELECT sc.Phone FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT sc.sname AS School_Name, s.Street AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY sc.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT s.City, COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City;
SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, f.`District Code` FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName3='Alusine'
SELECT s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS administrator FROM satscores sa JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND SOC = 62 AND DOC = 54;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.0018
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400 AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND s.EdOpsName = 'State Special School'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE (`Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500 ORDER BY CDSCode;

SELECT AVG(sa.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno'
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31';

SELECT s.School, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL)/f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL)/s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
ORDER BY free_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude = (SELECT MAX(Longitude) FROM schools);

SELECT s.CharterNum, ss.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rnk
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S' AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL AND ss.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSoffered = 'K-8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT f.`District Code`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.County, s.Virtual, sc.AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5 AND Virtual = 'F'
ORDER BY County, rnk;
SELECT s.School, sc.AvgScrWrite FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich' AND s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2 FROM schools WHERE County='San Bernardino' AND City='San Bernardino' AND District='San Bernardino City Unified' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND EILName='Intermediate/Middle/Junior High' AND DOCType='Unified School District'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" > 500

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)")
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School AS name, s.County AS county, ss.AvgScrRead AS ar,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn,
         s.Virtual
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE ss.rtype = 'S' AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 AND Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.School, sc.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.AdmLName1 LIKE '%Ulrich%' OR s.AdmLName2 LIKE '%Ulrich%' OR s.AdmLName3 LIKE '%Ulrich%';

SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT "School Name"
FROM frpm
WHERE "School Type" = 'State Special Schools'
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f."Charter School Number" AS "Charter School Number",
       s.AvgScrWrite AS "Average Writing Score",
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS "Rank"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND f."Charter School Number" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS avg_monthly_schools FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND DOCType = 'Elementary School District' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT T1."School Name", T2.Street
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1."Enrollment (K-12)" - T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30

SELECT T1.sname AS School, T1.enroll12 AS Enrollment
FROM satscores AS T1

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE StatusType='Merged' AND DOCType='Unified School District' AND County='Orange') * 1.0
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE StatusType='Merged' AND DOCType='Elementary School District' AND County='Orange') AS ratio;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
  SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
  FROM frpm f2
  JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
  WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT sc.School, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrMath DESC, sa.cds
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT s.School, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.GSserved = 'K-9';
SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND County IN ('San Diego','Santa Barbara') GROUP BY County ORDER BY num_schools DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Longitude DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  AND s.GSoffered = 'K-8'
GROUP BY s.City
SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, f.`District Code` FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName3='Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND DOCType = 'Unified School District' AND EILName = 'Intermediate/Middle/Junior High';

SELECT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Low Grade` = '1' AND `High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT f."School Name", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC='66' AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 1 AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 12
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT sc.Street, sc.City, sc.State, sc.Zip
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1 FROM satscores sa JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(sc.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores sc JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE sc.cname='Fresno' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31';

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT sa.cds, sa.sname, sa.cname, sa.AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cname ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM satscores sa
  WHERE sa.rtype = 'S' AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.School
FROM ranked r
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = r.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND r.rnk <= 5
ORDER BY s.School

SELECT sc.School, sat.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich';
SELECT `School Name`, `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm WHERE `District Type` = 'State Special Schools' ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC;
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OpenDate) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND DOCType = 'Elementary School District' AND OpenDate LIKE '1980%' GROUP BY m);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType='Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0 /
  SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType='Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType='Merged' AND County='Orange'

SELECT sc.School, sc.Street
FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`School Type` = 'State Special Schools'
  AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND s.City = 'Fremont'

SELECT s.School, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'
SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools WHERE County IN ('San Diego','Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County ORDER BY num_schools DESC;
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude = (SELECT MAX(Longitude) FROM schools)

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City
SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, f.`District Code` FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName3='Alusine'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino' AND s.District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
AND f.`School Type` = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
AND f.`District Type` = 'Unified School District';
